thread:
Rowan: Heads-up: milestone sync at 3pm. Need a firm cut for MVP vs v1 on Model Routing UI and tenant billing export. Proposal: MVP ships billing CSV export + backend counters; Model Routing UI deferred to v1.

Sofia: Agree on deferring the routing UI. Our customers can use API flags for now. Dev effort for billing export + counters ~5 dev days (Eli + 1). Routing UI is ~8 days with UX work.

Eli: Quick notes: counters (tokens, calls, P95, 5xx) + export endpoint = 4 dev days. Add 1 day for e2e and CD job. If we squeeze, we could prototype a minimal routing UI (no visuals, just toggles) but it eats QA time.

Harper: From CS: two pilot tenants asked explicitly for a billing CSV. They said routing UI is nice but not blocking. They also want an opt-out. We'll draft the customer note.

Rowan: Rollback and gating: suggested circuit-breaker for any tenant with >1.5x 5xx delta OR >10% P95 regression across models -> disable cache/routing for that tenant. Implement in runtime in ~2 days.

release-bot: Canary window suggestion: canary to single tenant Tue, expand to 3 tenants Wed, monitor 72h, GA after 7 days stable.

Sofia: Add a CI smoke that runs a small synthetic to validate P95 and token count doesn't regress >8%. Low cost in minutes.

Eli: I'll add the export endpoint, counters, CI smoke, and the rollback hooks tickets. Mark routing UI as v1.

Harper: I'll send pilot comms and include opt-out instructions and timeline.

Rowan: Decision: MVP = billing CSV + backend counters + CI smoke + runtime rollback hooks. v1 = Model Routing UI. Filing the milestone update now. :white_check_mark:
